    local record = {children = {}}
        local touched = false
        local okVariant, variant = pcall(function() return part.MaterialVariant end)
        if okVariant and variant ~= "" then
            record.variant = variant
            pcall(function() part.MaterialVariant = "" end)
            touched = true
        end
        if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
            local okTexture, textureId = pcall(function() return part.TextureID end)
            if okTexture and textureId ~= "" then
                record.textureId = textureId
                pcall(function() part.TextureID = "" end)
                touched = true
            end
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                table.insert(record.children, {kind = "appearance", instance = child})
                pcall(function() child.Parent = nil end)
                touched = true
            elseif child:IsA("Texture") or child:IsA("Decal") then
                local okAlpha, alpha = pcall(function() return child.Transparency end)
                if okAlpha and alpha < 1 then
                    table.insert(record.children, {kind = "decal", instance = child, transparency = alpha})
                    pcall(function() child.Transparency = 1 end)
                    touched = true
                end
            end
        end
        if touched then self.TextureOriginal[part] = record end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_restoreTextures()
        for part, record in pairs(self.TextureOriginal) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                if record.variant ~= nil then pcall(function() part.MaterialVariant = record.variant end) end
                if record.textureId ~= nil then pcall(function() part.TextureID = record.textureId end) end
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(record.children) do
                if item.kind == "appearance" then
                    if part and part.Parent and item.instance then pcall(function() item.instance.Parent = part end) end
                elseif item.instance and item.instance.Parent then
                    pcall(function() item.instance.Transparency = item.transparency end)
                end
            end
        end
        self.TextureOriginal = {}
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_applyWetPart(part)
        if not part or not part.Parent or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
        if part.Transparency >= 0.96 or part.Size.Magnitude < 1.2 then return false end
        local ancestor = part
        while ancestor do
            if string.sub(ancestor.Name or "", 1, 14) == "YinYangShader_" then return false end
            ancestor = ancestor.Parent
        end
        local ownerModel = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        local isLocalCharacter = ownerModel == (LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character)
        if isLocalCharacter and (self.ExcludeLocalAvatar or not self.CharacterSpecularEnabled) then return false end
        local inModel = ownerModel ~= nil
        if inModel and not self.ModelDetailEnabled then return false end
        local floorOnly = self.SurfaceMode == "Floors"
        if floorOnly and math.abs(part.CFrame.UpVector.Y) < 0.42 then return false end
        local multiplier = self:_surfaceMultiplier(part)
        if not multiplier then return false end
        if self.StripTextures then self:_stripPartTextures(part) end
        local ok, current = pcall(function() return part.Reflectance end)
        if not ok then return false end
        if self.Original[part] == nil then self.Original[part] = current end
        if inModel then multiplier = multiplier * 0.92 end
        local skyMirrorFloor = self:_isSkyMirrorFloor(part, inModel)
        if skyMirrorFloor then self:_applySkyMirrorSurface(part) end
        local applied = pcall(function()
            local wetReflectance = self.Original[part] + self.Intensity * self.Wetness * multiplier
            if skyMirrorFloor then wetReflectance = math.max(wetReflectance, self.SkyMirrorStrength) end
            part.Reflectance = math.clamp(wetReflectance, 0, 0.90)
        end)
        if applied then
            self.Applied[part] = true
            if inModel then self.ModelApplied[part] = true end
            if isLocalCharacter then self.CharacterApplied[part] = true end
        end
        return applied
    end

    function ShaderReflections:QueueSceneCoverage()
        if self.SceneBuilding or self.SceneComplete or not self.SceneCoverage then return end
        self.SceneBuilding, self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor = true, {}, 1
        task.spawn(function()
            local descendants = workspace:GetDescendants()
            for index, instance in ipairs(descendants) do
                if self.Enabled and instance:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(self.SceneQueue, instance) end
                if index % 240 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
            self.SceneBuilding = false
            self.SceneComplete = true
        end)
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_processSceneCoverage(limit)
        if not self.SceneCoverage then return end
        if self.SceneCursor > #self.SceneQueue then
            return
        end
        local processed = 0
        while processed < limit and self.SceneCursor <= #self.SceneQueue do
            self:_applyWetPart(self.SceneQueue[self.SceneCursor])
            self.SceneCursor = self.SceneCursor + 1
            processed = processed + 1
        end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_clearContact()
        if self.ContactRig and self.ContactRig.Parent then pcall(function() self.ContactRig:Destroy() end) end
        self.ContactRig, self.ContactParts, self.ContactCore = nil, {}, nil
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_clearSceneShadows()
        if self.ShadowConnection then self.ShadowConnection:Disconnect(); self.ShadowConnection = nil end
        if self.ShadowRig and self.ShadowRig.Parent then pcall(function() self.ShadowRig:Destroy() end) end
        self.ShadowRig, self.ShadowParts = nil, {}
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_refreshSceneShadows()
        if not self.ShadowEnabled then
            self:_clearSceneShadows()
            return
        end
        local character, root = self:_root()
        if not character or not root then return end
        if not self.ShadowRig or not self.ShadowRig.Parent then
            local rig = Instance.new("Folder")
            rig.Name = "YinYangShader_ModelShadows"
            rig.Parent = workspace
            self.ShadowRig, self.ShadowParts = rig, {}
        end

        local profile = shaderQualityProfile()
        local models, active, count = {}, {}, 0
        for _, part in ipairs((self:_sortedScan(root.Position, profile.shadowRadius, character))) do
            if count >= profile.shadowLimit then break end
            local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            if model and model ~= character and model.Parent and not models[model] then
                models[model] = true
                local okBounds, bounds, size = pcall(function() return model:GetBoundingBox() end)
                if okBounds and size and size.Magnitude >= 1.2 then
                    local params = RaycastParams.new()
                    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, self.ShadowRig, model}
                    params.IgnoreWater = false
                    local origin = bounds.Position + Vector3.new(0, math.max(2, size.Y * 0.55), 0)
                    local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -(math.max(10, size.Y + 16)), 0), params)
                    if hit and hit.Instance and math.abs(hit.Normal.Y) >= 0.34 then
                        count = count + 1
                        local proxy = self.ShadowParts[model]
                        if not proxy or not proxy.Parent then
                            proxy = Instance.new("Part")
                            proxy.Name = "YinYangShader_ModelShadow"
                            proxy.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                            proxy.Anchored, proxy.CanCollide, proxy.CanQuery, proxy.CanTouch, proxy.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
                            proxy.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                            proxy.Color = Color3.fromRGB(5, 7, 12)
                            proxy.Parent = self.ShadowRig
                            self.ShadowParts[model] = proxy
                        end
                        local right = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
                        if math.abs(right:Dot(hit.Normal)) > 0.92 then right = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
                        local back = hit.Normal:Cross(right).Unit
                        right = back:Cross(hit.Normal).Unit
                        proxy.Size = Vector3.new(
                            math.clamp(size.X * 0.70, 1.0, 18),
                            0.055,
                            math.clamp(size.Z * 0.70, 1.0, 18)
                        )
                        proxy.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(hit.Position + hit.Normal * (0.018 + count * 0.0002), right, hit.Normal, back)
                        proxy.Transparency = math.clamp(0.93 - self.ShadowStrength * 0.38, 0.64, 0.89)
                        active[model] = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for model, proxy in pairs(self.ShadowParts) do
            if not active[model] then
                if proxy and proxy.Parent then proxy:Destroy() end
                self.ShadowParts[model] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_refreshContact()
        if self.ExcludeLocalAvatar or not self.ContactEnabled or not self.Enabled then
            self:_clearContact()
            return
        end
        local character, root = self:_root()
        if not character or not root then return end
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, self.ContactRig}
        params.IgnoreWater = false
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), params)
        if not hit or not hit.Instance or math.abs(hit.Normal.Y) < 0.28 then
            self:_clearContact()
            return
        end
        if not self.ContactRig or not self.ContactRig.Parent then
            local rig = Instance.new("Folder")
            rig.Name = "YinYangShader_ContactReflection"
            rig.Parent = workspace
            self.ContactRig, self.ContactParts = rig, {}
        end

        local normal = hit.Normal
        local right = root.CFrame.RightVector
        if math.abs(right:Dot(normal)) > 0.92 then right = root.CFrame.LookVector end
        local back = normal:Cross(right).Unit
        right = back:Cross(normal).Unit
        local groundDistance = (root.Position - hit.Position).Magnitude
        local distanceFade = math.clamp(1 - math.max(0, groundDistance - 2.4) / 8.5, 0.18, 1)
        local wetFactor = math.clamp((self.Intensity * self.Wetness) / 0.34, 0.42, 1)

        if not self.ContactCore or not self.ContactCore.Parent then
            local core = Instance.new("Part")
            core.Name = "ContactReflectionCore"
            core.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            core.Anchored, core.CanCollide, core.CanQuery, core.CanTouch, core.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
            core.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
            core.Parent = self.ContactRig
            self.ContactCore = core
        end
        local extents = Vector3.new(3, 5, 2)
        pcall(function() extents = character:GetExtentsSize() end)
        self.ContactCore.Size = Vector3.new(
            math.clamp(extents.X * 0.52, 0.90, 4.8),
            0.026,
            math.clamp(extents.Z * 0.52, 0.90, 4.8)
        )
        self.ContactCore.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(hit.Position + normal * 0.019, right, normal, back)
        if self.OilSheen then
            self.ContactCore.Color = root.Color:Lerp(Color3.fromHSV((os.clock() * 0.07) % 1, 0.62, 1), 0.55)
        else
            self.ContactCore.Color = root.Color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(158, 198, 246), 0.46)
        end
        self.ContactCore.Transparency = math.clamp(0.95 - self.ContactStrength * 0.18 * wetFactor * distanceFade, 0.76, 0.93)

        local active, index = {}, 0
        for _, sourcePart in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if sourcePart:IsA("BasePart") and sourcePart.Transparency < 0.95 and sourcePart.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                if index >= 18 then break end
                local sourceHit = workspace:Raycast(sourcePart.Position + normal * 0.14, -normal * 9, params)
                if sourceHit and sourceHit.Instance and math.abs(sourceHit.Normal.Y) >= 0.28 then
                    index = index + 1
                    local proxy = self.ContactParts[sourcePart]
                    if not proxy or not proxy.Parent then
                        proxy = Instance.new("Part")
                        proxy.Name = "ContactReflection"
                        proxy.Anchored, proxy.CanCollide, proxy.CanQuery, proxy.CanTouch, proxy.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
                        proxy.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
                        proxy.Parent = self.ContactRig
                        self.ContactParts[sourcePart] = proxy
                    end
                    local sourceNormal = sourceHit.Normal
                    local sourceRight = right
                    if math.abs(sourceRight:Dot(sourceNormal)) > 0.92 then sourceRight = back end
                    local sourceBack = sourceNormal:Cross(sourceRight).Unit
                    sourceRight = sourceBack:Cross(sourceNormal).Unit
                    local size = sourcePart.Size
                    local partDistance = math.clamp((sourcePart.Position - sourceHit.Position).Magnitude, 0, 9)
                    local partFade = math.clamp(1 - math.max(0, partDistance - 2) / 7, 0.20, 1)
                    proxy.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(0.13, size.X * 0.78), 0.024, math.max(0.13, size.Z * 0.78))
                    proxy.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(sourceHit.Position + sourceNormal * (0.024 + index * 0.00014), sourceRight, sourceNormal, sourceBack)
                    if self.OilSheen then
                        proxy.Color = sourcePart.Color:Lerp(Color3.fromHSV((os.clock() * 0.07 + index * 0.09) % 1, 0.62, 1), 0.55)
                    else
                        proxy.Color = sourcePart.Color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(174, 211, 255), 0.42)
                    end
                    proxy.Transparency = math.clamp(0.93 - self.ContactStrength * 0.50 * wetFactor * partFade * distanceFade, 0.58, 0.89)
                    active[sourcePart] = true
                end
            end
        end
        for sourcePart, proxy in pairs(self.ContactParts) do
            if not active[sourcePart] then
                if proxy and proxy.Parent then proxy:Destroy() end
                self.ContactParts[sourcePart] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    -- Espejo de objetos: copias reflejadas (hacia abajo) de lo que hay sobre el suelo, vistas a traves del suelo
    -- semitransparente. Es opt-in y reversible: al apagarlo se restauran Transparency y Color de los suelos y se borran las copias.
    function ShaderReflections:_mirrorReflectVector(vector, normal)
        return vector - normal * (2 * vector:Dot(normal))
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_restoreMirrorFloor(part, record)
        if part and part.Parent and record then
            pcall(function()
                part.Transparency = record.transparency
                part.Color = record.color
                if record.castShadow ~= nil then part.CastShadow = record.castShadow end
            end)
        end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_clearMirror()
        if self.MirrorRig and self.MirrorRig.Parent then pcall(function() self.MirrorRig:Destroy() end) end
        self.MirrorRig, self.MirrorProxies, self.MirrorBacking = nil, {}, nil
        self.MirrorPlanePos, self.MirrorPlaneNormal, self.MirrorLostAt = nil, nil, nil
        self.MirrorLast = {}
        for part, record in pairs(self.MirrorFloors) do
            self:_restoreMirrorFloor(part, record)
        end
        self.MirrorFloors = {}
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_mirrorPlane(character, root)
        local excluded = {character}
        if self.MirrorRig then table.insert(excluded, self.MirrorRig) end
        local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
        for _ = 1, 4 do
            local params = RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
            params.IgnoreWater = true
            -- 40 studs: un salto normal no "pierde" el suelo (antes 16 y el reflejo se borraba al saltar)
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), params)
            if not hit or not hit.Instance or hit.Instance:IsA("Terrain") then return nil end
            if hit.Instance.Transparency >= 0.9 and not self.MirrorFloors[hit.Instance] then
                table.insert(excluded, hit.Instance)
            else
                if hit.Normal.Y < 0.9 then return nil end
                return hit.Position, hit.Normal, hit.Instance
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    -- Copia reflejada: mantiene material, malla, texturas y calcos del original (antes era Neon y se veía fantasma)
    function ShaderReflections:_createMirrorProxy(source)
        local ok, proxy = pcall(function()
            local copy = source:Clone()
            if not copy then return nil end
            copy:ClearAllChildren()
            for _, child in ipairs(source:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("SpecialMesh") or child:IsA("BlockMesh") or child:IsA("CylinderMesh")
                    or child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") or child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                    local okChild, childCopy = pcall(function() return child:Clone() end)
                    if okChild and childCopy then childCopy.Parent = copy end
                end
            end
            return copy
        end)
        if not ok or not proxy then
            local okFallback, fallback = pcall(function()
                local block = Instance.new("Part")
                if source:IsA("Part") then block.Shape = source.Shape end
                block.Size = source.Size
                block.Material = source.Material
                return block
            end)
            if not okFallback or not fallback then return nil end
            proxy = fallback
        end
        proxy.Name = "MirrorCopy"
        if proxy.Material == Enum.Material.ForceField then proxy.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic end
        proxy.Anchored, proxy.CanCollide, proxy.CanQuery, proxy.CanTouch, proxy.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
        pcall(function() proxy.Massless = true end)
        proxy.Parent = self.MirrorRig
        return proxy
    end

    -- Color aproximado del cielo (para el fondo del espejo): atmósfera > niebla > ambiente exterior
    function ShaderReflections:_mirrorSkyColor()
        local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        local color = lighting.OutdoorAmbient
        pcall(function()
            local atmosphere = lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if atmosphere then
                color = atmosphere.Color:Lerp(atmosphere.Decay, 0.35)
            else
                color = lighting.FogColor:Lerp(lighting.OutdoorAmbient, 0.4)
            end
        end)
        return color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.3)
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_updateMirror(force)
        local planePos, normal = self.MirrorPlanePos, self.MirrorPlaneNormal
        if not planePos or not normal or not self.MirrorRig then return end
        self.MirrorLast = self.MirrorLast or {}
        local deepest = 4
        for source, proxy in pairs(self.MirrorProxies) do
            if source and source.Parent and proxy and proxy.Parent then
                local cf = source.CFrame
                local height = (cf.Position - planePos):Dot(normal)
                local reach = height + source.Size.Magnitude * 0.5
                if reach > deepest then deepest = reach end
                -- solo se reubica si el original se movió (lo estático no cuesta nada por frame)
                if force or self.OilSheen or self.MirrorLast[source] ~= cf then
                    self.MirrorLast[source] = cf
                    local position = cf.Position - normal * (2 * height)
                    local rx = self:_mirrorReflectVector(cf.RightVector, normal)
                    local ry = self:_mirrorReflectVector(cf.UpVector, normal)
                    local rz = self:_mirrorReflectVector(-cf.LookVector, normal)
                    -- se desvanece apenas con la altura (como un piso pulido real), pero es sólido cerca del suelo
                    local fade = math.clamp((math.max(height, 0) - 10) / 36, 0, 1) * 0.55
                    pcall(function()
                        proxy.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(position, -rx, ry, rz)
                        if proxy.Size ~= source.Size then proxy.Size = source.Size end
                        local tinted = source.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.08)
                        if self.OilSheen then
                            tinted = tinted:Lerp(Color3.fromHSV((os.clock() * 0.05 + height * 0.03) % 1, 0.5, 1), 0.14)
                        end
                        proxy.Color = tinted
                        proxy.Transparency = math.clamp(source.Transparency + fade, 0, 0.9)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        -- (quitado) el panel de color de cielo que aparecia como un cuadrado bajo el jugador.
        -- Ahora el cielo y la luz se reflejan con el Reflectance real del piso (SkyMirror), no con un panel pintado.
        if self.MirrorBacking and self.MirrorBacking.Parent then pcall(function() self.MirrorBacking:Destroy() end) end
        self.MirrorBacking = nil
    end

    -- Partes de la zona ordenadas por distancia: así el límite elige siempre las mismas (antes el orden
    -- cambiaba en cada escaneo y los reflejos se apagaban y prendían solos cada ~1 s)
    function ShaderReflections:_sortedScan(origin, radius, character)
        local parts = self:_scan(origin, radius, character)
        local distance = {}
        for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
            distance[part] = (part.Position - origin).Magnitude
        end
        table.sort(parts, function(a, b) return distance[a] < distance[b] end)
        return parts, distance
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_refreshMirror()
        if not self.ObjectMirrorEnabled or not self.Enabled then
            self:_clearMirror()
            return
        end
        local character, root = self:_root()
        if not character or not root then return end
        local planePos, normal, hitPart = self:_mirrorPlane(character, root)
        if not planePos then
            -- se perdió el suelo un instante (salto, escalón, respawn): se espera antes de borrar todo
            self.MirrorLostAt = self.MirrorLostAt or os.clock()
            if os.clock() - self.MirrorLostAt > 1.6 then self:_clearMirror() end
            return
        end
        self.MirrorLostAt = nil
        -- pisar algo chico (un escalón, una mesa) no cambia el plano del espejo grande
        if self.MirrorPlanePos and hitPart and (hitPart.Size.X < 6 or hitPart.Size.Z < 6)
            and math.abs((planePos - self.MirrorPlanePos):Dot(normal)) < 8 then
            planePos, normal, hitPart = self.MirrorPlanePos, self.MirrorPlaneNormal, nil
        end
        local planeChanged = not self.MirrorPlanePos or math.abs((planePos - self.MirrorPlanePos):Dot(normal)) > 0.01
        self.MirrorPlanePos, self.MirrorPlaneNormal = planePos, normal
        if not self.MirrorRig or not self.MirrorRig.Parent then
            local rig = Instance.new("Folder")
            rig.Name = "YinYangShader_ObjectMirror"
            rig.Parent = workspace
            self.MirrorRig, self.MirrorProxies, self.MirrorBacking, self.MirrorLast = rig, {}, nil, {}
        end

        local profile = shaderQualityProfile()
        local factor = math.clamp(self.Intensity * self.Wetness / 0.45, 0.25, 1)
        local floorTransparency = math.clamp(self.MirrorFloorTransparency + 0.24 * factor, 0.36, 0.66)
        local floors, candidates, floorCount = {}, {}, 0
        local parts, distance = self:_sortedScan(root.Position, profile.mirrorRadius, nil)
        for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part:IsA("Terrain") and (part.Transparency < 0.9 or self.MirrorFloors[part]) then
                local parent = part.Parent
                local parentName = parent and parent.Name or ""
                if string.sub(parentName, 1, 14) ~= "YinYangShader_" then
                    local relative = part.Position - planePos
                    local height = relative:Dot(normal)
                    local floorLike = math.abs(part.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(normal)) >= 0.97
                        and part.Size.X >= 4 and part.Size.Z >= 4 and part.Size.Y <= 5
                        and math.abs(height + part.Size.Y * 0.5) <= 0.35
                    if part == hitPart or floorLike then
                        if floorCount < 80 then
                            floors[part] = true
                            floorCount = floorCount + 1
                        end
                    elseif part.Size.Magnitude <= 360 and part.Size.Magnitude >= 0.5 and height > -0.2 then
                        table.insert(candidates, {part = part, distance = distance[part] or relative.Magnitude})
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if hitPart and hitPart:IsA("BasePart") then floors[hitPart] = true end

        for part in pairs(floors) do
            if not self.MirrorFloors[part] then
                self.MirrorFloors[part] = {transparency = part.Transparency, color = part.Color, castShadow = part.CastShadow}
            end
            local record = self.MirrorFloors[part]
            pcall(function()
                part.Transparency = math.max(record.transparency, floorTransparency)
                part.Color = record.color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.12)
                -- sin la sombra del piso, las copias de abajo reciben la luz del sol como el original
                part.CastShadow = false
            end)
        end
        for part, record in pairs(self.MirrorFloors) do
            if not floors[part] then
                self:_restoreMirrorFloor(part, record)
                self.MirrorFloors[part] = nil
            end
        end

        local wanted = {}
        for index = 1, math.min(#candidates, profile.mirrorLimit) do
            wanted[candidates[index].part] = true
        end
        for source, proxy in pairs(self.MirrorProxies) do
            if not wanted[source] or not source.Parent then
                if proxy and proxy.Parent then proxy:Destroy() end
                self.MirrorProxies[source] = nil
                self.MirrorLast[source] = nil
            end
        end
        -- primera vez: se arma todo de una (antes 24 por escaneo = 2-3 s sin reflejo al aplicar)
        local budget = next(self.MirrorProxies) == nil and profile.mirrorLimit or 48
        local created = 0
        for index = 1, math.min(#candidates, profile.mirrorLimit) do
            if created >= budget then break end
            local source = candidates[index].part
            if not self.MirrorProxies[source] then
                local proxy = self:_createMirrorProxy(source)
                if proxy then
                    self.MirrorProxies[source] = proxy
                    created = created + 1
                end
            end
        end
        self:_updateMirror(planeChanged)
    end

    function ShaderReflections:_recover()
        -- al cambiar de ronda el mapa se rehace: limpiamos refs muertas y volvemos a cubrir el mapa nuevo
        for part in pairs(self.Original) do
            if not (part and part.Parent) then
                self.Original[part] = nil; self.Applied[part] = nil
                self.ModelApplied[part] = nil; self.CharacterApplied[part] = nil
            end
        end
        self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor, self.SceneComplete = {}, 1, false
        self:_clearMirror()
        local _, root = self:_root()
        self.SceneAnchor = root and root.Position or self.SceneAnchor
        self:Refresh()
        self:QueueSceneCoverage()
    end

    function ShaderReflections:Refresh()
        if not self.Enabled then return end
        local character, root = self:_root()
        if not root then return end
        if self.SceneAnchor and (root.Position - self.SceneAnchor).Magnitude > 600 then
            self.SceneAnchor = root.Position
            for part in pairs(self.Original) do
                if not (part and part.Parent) then self.Original[part] = nil; self.Applied[part] = nil end
            end
            self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor, self.SceneComplete = {}, 1, false
            self:QueueSceneCoverage()
        elseif not self.SceneAnchor then
            self.SceneAnchor = root.Position
        end
        local profile = shaderQualityProfile()
        local active, count = {}, 0
        local parts, distance = self:_sortedScan(root.Position, profile.reflectionRadius, character)
        for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
            if count >= profile.reflectionLimit then break end
            if not part:IsDescendantOf(character) and self:_applyWetPart(part) then
                active[part] = true
                count = count + 1
            end
        end
        if self.CharacterSpecularEnabled and character then
            local characterCount = 0
            for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                if characterCount >= 28 then break end
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and self:_applyWetPart(part) then
                    active[part] = true
                    characterCount = characterCount + 1
                end
            end
        end
        if not self.SceneCoverage then
            -- histéresis: lo que ya brillaba se queda mientras siga dentro del radio (sin parpadeo en el borde del límite)
            local keepRadius = profile.reflectionRadius * 1.15
            for part in pairs(self.Applied) do
                local near = part and part.Parent and distance[part] ~= nil and distance[part] <= keepRadius
                if not active[part] and not near and not self.CharacterApplied[part] then
                    local original = self.Original[part]
                    if original ~= nil and part and part.Parent then pcall(function() part.Reflectance = original end) end
                    self.Original[part] = nil
                    self.Applied[part] = nil
                end
            end
        end
        if self.SceneCoverage and #self.SceneQueue == 0 then self:QueueSceneCoverage() end
        self:_refreshContact()
        self:_refreshSceneShadows()
    end

    function ShaderReflections:Restore()
        for part, original in pairs(self.Original) do
            if part and part.Parent then pcall(function() part.Reflectance = original end) end
        end
        self.Original, self.Applied, self.ModelApplied, self.CharacterApplied = {}, {}, {}, {}
        self:_restoreSkyMirror()
        self:_restoreTextures()
        self:_clearContact()
        self:_clearMirror()
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetIntensity(value)
        local newValue = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or self.Intensity, 0.05, 0.60)
        if newValue == self.Intensity then
            if self.Enabled then self:Refresh() end
            return
        end
        self.Intensity = newValue
        if self.Enabled then
            self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor, self.SceneComplete = {}, 1, false
            self:Refresh()
        end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetWetness(value)
        local newValue = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or self.Wetness, 0.10, 1)
        if newValue == self.Wetness then
            if self.Enabled then self:Refresh() end
            return
        end
        self.Wetness = newValue
        if self.Enabled then
            self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor, self.SceneComplete = {}, 1, false
            self:Refresh()
        end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetSurfaceMode(mode)
        local newMode = mode == "Floors" and "Floors" or "All"
        -- mismo valor: no se restaura nada (antes cada preset hacía Restore y el efecto se apagaba un momento)
        if newMode == self.SurfaceMode then return end
        self.SurfaceMode = newMode
        if self.Enabled then
            self:Restore()
            self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor, self.SceneComplete = {}, 1, false
            self:Refresh()
        end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetSceneCoverage(enabled)
        enabled = enabled == true
        if enabled == self.SceneCoverage then return end
        self.SceneCoverage = enabled
        if self.Enabled then
            self:Restore()
            self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor, self.SceneComplete = {}, 1, false
            self:Refresh()
        end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetSkyMirrorEnabled(enabled)
        self.SkyMirrorEnabled = enabled == true
        if not self.SkyMirrorEnabled then
            self:_restoreSkyMirror()
        end
        if self.Enabled then
            self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor, self.SceneComplete = {}, 1, false
            self:Refresh()
        end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetStripTexturesEnabled(enabled)
        self.StripTextures = enabled == true
        if not self.StripTextures then
            self:_restoreTextures()
        end
        if self.Enabled then
            self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor, self.SceneComplete = {}, 1, false
            self:Refresh()
        end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetObjectMirrorEnabled(enabled)
        self.ObjectMirrorEnabled = enabled == true
        if not self.ObjectMirrorEnabled then
            self:_clearMirror()
        elseif self.Enabled then
            self.MirrorScanElapsed = 0
            self:_refreshMirror()
        end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetContactStrength(value)
        self.ContactStrength = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or self.ContactStrength, 0.05, 0.60)
        self:_refreshContact()
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetContactEnabled(enabled)
        self.ContactEnabled = enabled == true
        self:_refreshContact()
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetModelDetailEnabled(enabled)
        self.ModelDetailEnabled = enabled == true
        if not self.ModelDetailEnabled then
            for part in pairs(self.ModelApplied) do
                local original = self.Original[part]
                if part and part.Parent and original ~= nil then pcall(function() part.Reflectance = original end) end
                self.Original[part] = nil
                self.Applied[part] = nil
            end
            self.ModelApplied = {}
        end
        if self.Enabled then
            self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor, self.SceneComplete = {}, 1, false
            self:Refresh()
        end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetCharacterSpecularEnabled(enabled)
        self.CharacterSpecularEnabled = enabled == true
        if not self.CharacterSpecularEnabled then
            for part in pairs(self.CharacterApplied) do
                local original = self.Original[part]
                if part and part.Parent and original ~= nil then pcall(function() part.Reflectance = original end) end
                self.Original[part] = nil
                self.Applied[part] = nil
                self.ModelApplied[part] = nil
            end
            self.CharacterApplied = {}
        end
        if self.Enabled then self:Refresh() end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetExcludeLocalAvatar(enabled)
        self.ExcludeLocalAvatar = enabled == true
        if self.ExcludeLocalAvatar then
            for part in pairs(self.CharacterApplied) do
                local original = self.Original[part]
                if part and part.Parent and original ~= nil then pcall(function() part.Reflectance = original end) end
                self.Original[part] = nil
                self.Applied[part] = nil
                self.ModelApplied[part] = nil
            end
            self.CharacterApplied = {}
        end
        self:_refreshContact()
        if self.Enabled then self:Refresh() end
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetShadowEnabled(enabled)
        enabled = enabled == true
        if self.ShadowEnabled == enabled then
            if enabled then self:_refreshSceneShadows() else self:_clearSceneShadows() end
            return
        end
        self.ShadowEnabled = enabled
        if not enabled then
            self:_clearSceneShadows()
            return
        end
        self.ShadowElapsed = 0
        self.ShadowConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
            self.ShadowElapsed = self.ShadowElapsed + delta
            if self.ShadowElapsed >= 0.34 then
                self.ShadowElapsed = 0
                self:_refreshSceneShadows()
            end
        end)
        self:_refreshSceneShadows()
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetShadowStrength(value)
        self.ShadowStrength = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or self.ShadowStrength, 0.05, 0.70)
        self:_refreshSceneShadows()
    end

    function ShaderReflections:SetEnabled(enabled)
        enabled = enabled == true
        if self.Enabled == enabled then
            if enabled then self:Refresh() end
            return
        end
        self.Enabled = enabled
        if not enabled then
            if self.Connection then self.Connection:Disconnect(); self.Connection = nil end
            if self.CharacterConn then self.CharacterConn:Disconnect(); self.CharacterConn = nil end
            self:Restore()
            self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor, self.SceneComplete = {}, 1, false
            return
        end
        self.SceneQueue, self.SceneCursor, self.SceneComplete = {}, 1, false
        self:Refresh()
        self:QueueSceneCoverage()
        self.Elapsed = 0
        self.Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
            self.Elapsed = self.Elapsed + delta
            self.ContactElapsed = self.ContactElapsed + delta
            self.SceneElapsed = self.SceneElapsed + delta
            if self.SceneElapsed >= 0.08 then
                self.SceneElapsed = 0
                self:_processSceneCoverage(90)
            end
            if self.ContactElapsed >= 0.12 then
                self.ContactElapsed = 0
                self:_refreshContact()
            end
            if self.ShadowElapsed >= 0.34 and not self.ShadowConnection then
                self.ShadowElapsed = 0
                self:_refreshSceneShadows()
            end
            self.MirrorScanElapsed = self.MirrorScanElapsed + delta
            self.MirrorStepElapsed = self.MirrorStepElapsed + delta
            if self.ObjectMirrorEnabled then
                if self.MirrorScanElapsed >= 0.5 then
                    self.MirrorScanElapsed, self.MirrorStepElapsed = 0, 0
                    self:_refreshMirror()
                elseif self.MirrorStepElapsed >= 1 / 30 then
                    self.MirrorStepElapsed = 0
                    self:_updateMirror()
                end
            end
            if self.Elapsed >= 1.15 then
                self.Elapsed = 0
                self:Refresh()
            end
        end)
        do local _, r0 = self:_root(); self.SceneAnchor = r0 and r0.Position or nil end
        if self.CharacterConn then self.CharacterConn:Disconnect() end
        self.CharacterConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.5) -- esperar a que cargue el mapa/cuerpo de la nueva ronda
            if self.Enabled then self:_recover() end
        end)
    end

    function ShaderReflections:ApplyGoldenFinish()
        self.OilSheen = false
        self:SetSceneCoverage(false)
        self:SetSurfaceMode("All")
        self:SetModelDetailEnabled(true)
        self:SetCharacterSpecularEnabled(true)
        self:SetIntensity(0.46)
        self:SetWetness(0.96)
        self:SetContactStrength(0.38)
        self:SetContactEnabled(true)
        self:SetShadowStrength(0.46)
        self:SetShadowEnabled(true)
        self:SetEnabled(true)
    end

    function ShaderReflections:ApplyOilFinish()
        self.OilSheen = true
        self:SetSceneCoverage(false)
        self:SetSurfaceMode("All")
        self:SetModelDetailEnabled(true)
        self:SetCharacterSpecularEnabled(true)
        self:SetSkyMirrorEnabled(true)
        self:SetStripTexturesEnabled(true)
        self:SetIntensity(0.60)
        self:SetWetness(1)
        self:SetContactStrength(0.45)
        self:SetContactEnabled(true)
        self:SetShadowStrength(0.46)
        self:SetShadowEnabled(true)
        self:SetObjectMirrorEnabled(true)
        self:SetEnabled(true)
    end

    -- Espejo realista sin aceite (Ciudad Neón): piso espejo con copias sólidas, sin quitar texturas
    function ShaderReflections:ApplyMirrorFinish()
        self.OilSheen = false
        self:SetSceneCoverage(false)
        self:SetSurfaceMode("All")
        self:SetModelDetailEnabled(true)
        self:SetCharacterSpecularEnabled(true)
        self:SetStripTexturesEnabled(false)
        self:SetSkyMirrorEnabled(true)
        self:SetIntensity(0.50)
        self:SetWetness(1)
        self:SetContactStrength(0.40)
        self:SetContactEnabled(true)
        self:SetShadowStrength(0.40)
        self:SetShadowEnabled(true)
        self:SetObjectMirrorEnabled(true)
        self:SetEnabled(true)
    end

    local ShaderSolarTone = {
        Hue = 0.10,
        Saturation = 0.38,
        Strength = 0.42,
    }

    function ShaderSolarTone:Apply()
        local tint = Color3.fromHSV(self.Hue, self.Saturation, 1)
        local top = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(tint, self.Strength)
        local bottomBase = Color3.fromRGB(176, 194, 226)
        local bottom = bottomBase:Lerp(tint, self.Strength * 0.44)
        return ShaderManager:Apply({Lighting = {ColorShift_Top = top, ColorShift_Bottom = bottom}}, {tween = true, duration = 0.28})
    end

    function ShaderSolarTone:SetHue(value)
        self.Hue = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or self.Hue, 0, 1)
        return self:Apply()
    end

    function ShaderSolarTone:SetSaturation(value)
        self.Saturation = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or self.Saturation, 0, 1)
        return self:Apply()
    end

    function ShaderSolarTone:SetStrength(value)
        self.Strength = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or self.Strength, 0, 1)
        return self:Apply()
    end

    local ShaderManualLighting = {
        Brightness = ShaderLightingService.Brightness,
        ExposureCompensation = ShaderLightingService.ExposureCompensation,
    }

    local ShaderSilhouette = {
        Enabled = false,
        Original = {},
        ClothingOriginal = {},
        TerrainOriginal = {},
        TerrainWaterColor = nil,
        Connection = nil,
        ScanToken = 0,
    }

    function ShaderSilhouette:_applyPart(part)
        if not self.Enabled or not part or not part.Parent or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        if string.sub(part.Name or "", 1, 14) == "YinYangShader_" then return end

        if self.Original[part] == nil then
            self.Original[part] = {}
            pcall(function() self.Original[part].Color = part.Color end)
            pcall(function() self.Original[part].Reflectance = part.Reflectance end)
        end

        pcall(function() part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) end)
        pcall(function() part.Reflectance = 0 end)

        for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                if self.Original[child] == nil then
                    self.Original[child] = {}
                    pcall(function() self.Original[child].Color = child.Color end)
                end
                pcall(function() child.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) end)
            end
        end
    end

    function ShaderSilhouette:_applyClothing(instance)
        if not self.Enabled or not instance or not instance.Parent then return end
        local property
        if
